name: Rebecca Bowen Creed
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Jacksonville, Florida
education: University of North Carolina School of Law
about: Rebecca Bowen Creed attended law school and graduated from University of North Carolina School of Law in 1991. Rebecca Creed began practicing law in 1991.
Rebecca Creed is an attorney at Creed & Gowdy, PA, helping people with Appellate issues. Creed & Gowdy, PA has an office in Jacksonville, Florida, serving the local community.

Rebecca Creed was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
